k_selection.mdl_note: gain as a fraction of the i.i.d. code length is the interpretable scale; a fraction below ~0.01 is a weak preference however large the bit count looks

mdl_calibration.note: permutation null not run (n_perm=0). Re-run with run(..., n_perm=199) for a p-value; cost is O(n_perm * T * m * n^3). The default evidence for real structure is result['post_clustering_inference'].

artifact_diagnostics.empty_stratum_layer: all layers (largest group against the rest)
artifact_diagnostics.note: empty_stratum_ari compares the partition to the indicator 'carries none of this layer's features', and largest_group compares the largest group against the rest with the indicator 'carries none of any layer's features'; max_empty_stratum_ari is the larger of the two and a value at or above 0.5 means the grouping is the trait-absent stratum, an artefact of the empty-union distance convention rather than trait structure

layer_influence.n_perm_note: permutation test skipped at n = 1500 (> 500): it costs 2 * n_perm * n_layers network fusions. Force it with run(..., influence_n_perm=10).

baselines.note: ari_vs_fused says only whether a candidate agrees with the reported partition. mdl_gain is in sample and favours a likelihood-fitted candidate by construction. external_agreement is a point value; the paired difference in external_agreement_vs_reported carries the interval that says whether two candidates can be told apart. held_out is the feature-split test the reported partition must pass, run on each candidate's own pipeline. The reported partition is attested by its own held-out test; it is not claimed to be the best of these candidates, and the report states which candidates the data can and cannot separate.

lineage_concordance.note: the pair concordance, not AMI/ARI, is the primary statistic: with many singleton lineages AMI is chance-corrected towards zero even under strong clonal confounding

lineage_concordance_variants_collapsed.note: the pair concordance, not AMI/ARI, is the primary statistic: with many singleton lineages AMI is chance-corrected towards zero even under strong clonal confounding

leave_one_stratum_out.note: public AST is deposited in collections, so a head-to-head that one collection can reverse is a statement about that collection rather than about the cohort

phenotype_validation.how_to_read_this: mean_balanced_accuracy is over the FDR *family* (every antibiotic with >= min_tested tested isolates), not over the significant subset; the significant subset is selected on the partition's own p-value and flatters it, and both are reported. orientation_null_floor is what the statistic returns on permuted labels -- around 0.55, not 0.50, because balanced accuracy is maximised over both label orientations -- so a raw value near 0.55 is chance. partition_beats is False only when the competitor's advantage survives an isolate-level bootstrap; a point difference of a couple of percent does not.
phenotype_validation.what_this_tests: whether the discovered partition predicts laboratory-measured non-susceptibility, and whether it does so better than the competing one-column rules. A partition that does not beat 'carries any acquired determinant' has added nothing that a single indicator column did not already provide.

label_recoverability.note: recovery of the pipeline's own labels from half the features; internal coherence, not external predictive validity

post_clustering_inference.method: multi-split feature splitting; split p-values merged by Gasparin, Wang & Ramdas (2025) PNAS 122:e2410849122 Thm 4.1
post_clustering_inference.validity_note: the split is drawn over whole feature blocks; the strongest correlation between two blocks is 0.70 and the largest block holds 16% of the features. Block-aware splitting has family-wise error 0.000-0.067 against a nominal 0.05 under a no-cluster null with correlated features
post_clustering_inference.what_this_tests: H0: held-out features are independent of the labels learned from the discovery features. Rejection means detectable structure, NOT necessarily discrete archetypes - see 'discreteness'

discreteness.null_model: 3-factor logistic latent trait (one population, 3 continuous gradients, features correlated through them), marginal likelihood by Gauss-Hermite quadrature; q chosen by BIC over 1..4
discreteness.note: a significant feature-split p-value with a non-significant value here means structure without evidence of discreteness. A boundary optimum is returned before bootstrap with status withheld_under_dimensioned and a null verdict.

count_thinning_comparison.method: multi-split NB data thinning (Neufeld et al. 2024 JMLR 25(57); merged by Gasparin, Wang & Ramdas 2025 PNAS 122:e2410849122)
count_thinning_comparison.reason: negative-binomial size parameters were estimated from the matrix being split or were supplied without a validated source; the resulting p-values are diagnostic, not nominal
count_thinning_comparison.note: corr(X1, X2) should be ~0; a systematically non-zero value means the assumed negative-binomial family or its estimated dispersion is wrong; a near-zero value alone does not validate parameters estimated from the same matrix (Neufeld et al. 2024 JMLR 25(57) Prop. 11)

excluded_from_fdr.reason: mutually exclusive indicators are one hypothesis, not p

gate_ledger.threshold: no tested simple rule has bootstrap CI95 low > 0

interpretation.scope_note: Highest claim supported by diagnostics applicable to this run; archetype_candidate is not causal, clinical or cross-cohort biological confirmation.
